warnings: Slab view of the combined column/beam/slab plan (etc_plan = slab plan). PS = แผ่นพื้นสำเร็จรูป (solid plank) laid in every half-bay panel between B5/B6/B7 with a span arrow: 67 panels counted (A-B: 2 in bay 1-2 full depth, 11 + 11 above/below B11 from grid 2 to 7', 1 below B12 in 7'-8; rows B-E: 14 half-bays x 3).

S1 (cast-in-place on beams): 7 canopy panels above row A (1'''''-2 then one per bay to 8) + 2 small panels at 7'-8 x A-A'''' either side of B8 = 9. S2: the grid-1 canopy bay (1-1''''') with a 'Slope' arrow.

GS (slab on grade, รายการประกอบแบบพื้น ข้อ 2): the perimeter walkway, printed as 7 circle markers (left of grid 1 at A-B and at row D, right of grid 8 at A-B and at row D, below row E in bays 1-2, 4-5, 7-8). count = markers printed, not separate slabs — take the quantity from the strip area (1.50 outside grids 1, 8 and E).
S1/S2/GS thickness and rebar are on the section sheet S-07 (page 22), not reached in this run.
